Anika: Hitting a 'vectors length mismatch' from the node sampleapp when using the batching helper. Python SDK works.
Anika: Minimal curl that reproduces it (redacted token):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/rerank -H "Authorization: Bearer $T" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"rerank-open-1","queries":["a"],"candidates":["only"],"embeddings":{"queries":[[0.12,0.34]],"candidates":[0.45,0.67]}}'
```
Anika: Notice candidates embedding is flat (should be [[...]]). This happens when one request in a batched pack has a single candidate and the helper fastpath flattens it. Also saw a token refresh/retry in the trace.
Chris: Sounds like the helper's fastpath + retry repack combo. I'll add a sanitizer in the node batching helper that enforces array-of-arrays for embeddings and add a unit that simulates a 401 refresh + retry.
Maria: Please also add a brief README note for the sampleapp explaining what the SDK does on retry and this edge case.
devex-bot: PR opened: pr/5310 — node helper sanitizer + tests. :white_check_mark:
Anika: Thanks — I'll validate on staging and report back.
